messages:
maya: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp started hitting a bunch of 429s during ramp tests. looks like client-side prefetch + conn-pool interaction. anyone seen this pattern?
ryan: saw a spike in our lab cluster logs this morning, similar. which SDK?
maya: js-sdk in the repro but i suspect parity issue across SDKs. repro steps: start sampleapp with prefetch window=3 and pool=10, then parallelize 50 workers.
ryan: logs?
maya: pasted snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] INFO request id=abc123 queued
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] DEBUG pool checkout socket=7
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] WARN upstream 429 model=redwood/gpt-open-27b reason=rate_limit
[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] DEBUG pool return socket=7
```
sophie: hmm looks like semaphore counting is per-request but the pool hands out sockets outside of the SDK rate limiter. so prefetch will issue more inflight connections than our logical concurrency.
samir: that's what i thought. js-sdk's prefetch batcher calls fetchConcurrent() which only gates fetches but not underlying socket reuse leading to bursts. python/go had a different net layer and didn't show it.
ryan: interesting — that would explain parity gap. could be a race where prefetch enqueues N tasks and the connection pool drains them concurrently ignoring the SDK limit.
maya: propose short-term: disable prefetch in quickstarts, update sampleapp docs to recommend window=1 for onboarding. long-term: sdk should own an inflight semaphore that wraps connection checkout.
sophie: agree. PR for docs? i can do the docs patch.
samir: i'll prototype a wrapper that does:
```js
async function guardedFetch(fn) {
  await inflightSemaphore.acquire();
  try { return await fn(); } finally { inflightSemaphore.release(); }
}
```
ryan: also add metrics so we can see socket checkouts vs logical inflight. add counter: pool_checkouts, sdk_inflight.
maya: can someone open an issue in devex-sdk repo and label sdk-parity + high?
ryan: i'll open it and assign to @samir for an initial patch. will add repro script and the lab logs.
sophie: docs PR: i'll add onboarding note + example config and link to issue.
maya: tl;dr: root cause = prefetch + conn-pool bypass of SDK-level concurrency = bursts -> 429s; mitigation = docs + disable prefetch; fix = semaphore at SDK+metrics + parity across languages. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: Incident template created: #1234 - onboarding-sampleapp-429-prefetch-connpool
ryan: pinging eng-runtime to see if they want to add a server-side soft-throttle too, just in case.
maya: thanks all, i'll update the sampleapp test matrix after the issue lands.
